OCR character confusion 3↔8."},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"702.00","issue":"OCR mis-read 102.00 as 702.00 on the 'Total incl. of GST' line. Correct total appears multiple times (Subtotal: 102.00, Total Amt Rounded 102.00, Payment: 102.00); last-candidate selection picked a corrupted line."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.26","issue":"Image shows TOTAL: 23.25 (after rounding adj -0.01), but OCR picked 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' from the pre-rounding line. The final TOTAL line is distinct and later; the extractor should prefer the final 'TOTAL:' line over 'Total (Inclusive of GST)'."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":null,"issue":"Grand Total 92.80 clearly present but extractor returned null. Likely because the 'Grand Total' OCR read as 'GrandTota. = tS 92.80' and the generic TOTAL tier matched a different line (e.g., 'Total — 92:80' with colon-as-period issue) or exclusion/regex failure. Null means no tier matched extractable number."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"Candidate selection within a tier picks the LAST matching line, which can be an OCR-garbled duplicate instead of the clean final total. Multiple equal totals appear on receipts (Total, Total Rounded, Payment, Grand Total); choosing the last one is fragile."},{"id":"rc2","summary":"No cross-validation across multiple total-like lines on the same receipt. When several candidate totals exist, picking the mode/majority value would correct single-line OCR errors (e.g., 702 vs three 102s on 074)."},{"id":"rc3","summary":"Priority tier for 'TOTAL' is too generic and does not distinguish 'TOTAL:' (final summary) from 'Total (Inclusive of GST):' (pre-rounding) or inline 'Total' per item. Receipts often have a final large-print 'TOTAL:' that should outrank 'Total (Inclusive of ...)' when a later 'Rounding Adj' and 'TOTAL:' both appear."},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Fallback for null extraction is weak. When regex-based TOTAL matching fails due to OCR noise (e.g., colon rendered as period, decimal rendered as colon like '92:80'), there is no numeric-repair step (replace ':' between digits with '.', collapse spaces) and no last-resort scan for the largest money-shaped number near a TOTAL keyword."},{"id":"rc5","summary":"Date parser ambiguity between DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY is not addressed. Malaysian receipts are DD/MM/YYYY, but OCR can swap digits (3↔8). No sanity check against other date hints on the receipt (e.g., 'PRN ON' line, 'Closed' line) to triangulate."},{"id":"rc6","summary":"Single OCR pass with default PSM. For low-contrast or rotated/handwritten-overlay receipts, multi-pass OCR (preprocess + alternate PSM) would reduce single-digit misreads driving both date and amount errors."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"The current image-ocr skill explains multi-pass OCR and gives a receipt-oriented structured extractor, but it does not codify: (a) selecting a canonical total via majority-vote across all total-like lines on a receipt, (b) distinguishing 'final rounded TOTAL' from 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' when both exist, (c) numeric-glyph repair for common OCR confusions in money fields (':' -> '.', 'O'->'0', 'l'/'I'->'1', 'S'->'5' only in digit context), (d) using secondary date lines (Closed/PRN ON) to disambiguate ambiguous DD/MM. These are generic receipt-OCR concerns, not task-specific."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority ordering described treats generic 'TOTAL' as a single tier; it should recommend a sub-ordering: prefer lines matching 'TOTAL\\s*:\\s*<amount>' at start-of-line (final total print) and lines like 'Total Rounded' / 'Rounded Total' / 'Net Total' / 'Grand Total' over 'Total (Inclusive of ...)' and over inline 'Total' column headers."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Number regex example only accepts amounts with explicit decimals in strict form; it does not guide normalization of OCR-corrupted decimals (e.g., '92:80', '92,80', '92-80') before applying the regex, which caused the 078 null."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR section is advisory; the skill does not instruct that a per-receipt fallback MUST retry with preprocessing (grayscale+autocontrast+upscale) and PSM 6/4 when either field returns None, which would recover cases like 078."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"The xlsx guidance does not warn that when writing extracted monetary strings formatted to 2 decimals, pandas/openpyxl can coerce them to floats, producing '47.7' instead of '47.70'. image-ocr already notes this but xlsx should reinforce writing object-dtype strings and setting cell number_format='@' when string preservation is required by downstream exact-match checks."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Receipt total selection algorithm' subsection that: (1) collects ALL numeric candidates from every non-excluded line matching any TOTAL/AMOUNT tier; (2) normalizes each line's numbers after glyph repair; (3) returns the value with the highest frequency across tiers (majority vote), breaking ties by preferring the highest-priority tier and, within the same tier, the LAST occurrence. Include pseudocode."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Refine the priority tier list to explicitly place 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'NET TOTAL', 'NETT TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', and standalone 'TOTAL:' (start-of-line colon form) above generic 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' and inline 'Total' columns. Document that 'Total (Inclusive of ...)' should be used only if no post-rounding/final total line exists."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an OCR glyph-repair step for monetary tokens: before number regex, replace within digit runs: ':' between two digits -> '.', ',' between a digit and two digits -> '.' only when followed by exactly two digits at end-of-token, 'O'->'0', 'l'/'I'->'1'. Keep the repair local to candidate total lines to avoid altering other text."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Mandate a two-pass fallback: if extract_total or extract_date returns None, re-run OCR using preprocess_for_receipt() with PSM 6 and PSM 4 and re-apply extraction before giving up. Document this as a required loop in the batch pipeline."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand date extraction with: (a) secondary-signal disambiguation (search for 'Closed:', 'PRN ON', 'Print Date', 'Date :' lines and cross-check day/month plausibility), (b) when both candidate orderings are plausible, prefer DD/MM/YYYY (receipts domain default) and record a confidence flag, (c) sanity-check that month<=12 and reject implausible years."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit guidance that total_amount strings must be written as strings with exactly two decimals and that NaN/None propagates as empty cell (not 'None' or 'nan'). Reference the xlsx skill for writer-side preservation."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short 'String-typed numeric columns' note: when exact string matching is required downstream (e.g., '47.70'), set the column dtype to object, pre-format values in Python, and apply cell number_format='@' via openpyxl to prevent Excel/LibreOffice from re-interpreting them as numbers."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a reminder that None/NaN in object columns should be written as empty cells; recommend converting pandas NaN to None before to_excel for columns that must represent 'missing' as blank rather than the string 'nan'."}],"confidence":0.72}
